blocks.text: (Image from Pagasa) MANILA, Philippines — Heavy to intense rains may hit parts of Metro Manila and Luzon due to localized thunderstorms on Tuesday afternoon, according to the state weather bureau. In a thunderstorm advisory issued at 1:55 p.m., the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said that heavy to intense rains with lightning and strongwinds may affect the following areas within the next two hours.
